summary: 周日非常安静，当天没有新的 EIP、ERC 或论坛重点帖。barnabemonnot 提到 ERC-8211 并抄送 Biconomy。Eli Ben-Sasson 谈比特币引入 op_cat 与 op_STARK 的设想。

items.title: Eli Ben-Sasson：与其制造新问题，不如推动比特币加入 op_cat 和 op_STARK 这类能解决问题的功能
items.title_en: Eli Ben-Sasson: rather than create new problems, push Bitcoin to add things like op_cat and op_STARK that solve problems

items.title: LefterisJP：质押 ETH 需要能管理验证者、核算奖励与损益的记账工具
items.title_en: LefterisJP: if you stake ETH you need an accounting tool that manages validators and tracks rewards, losses and PnL

summary_en: A very quiet Sunday with no new EIPs, ERCs or notable forum posts. barnabemonnot mentioned ERC-8211 and tagged Biconomy. Eli Ben-Sasson talked about adding op_cat and op_STARK to Bitcoin.
